decisions.reason: The multi-model bleaching tray line had its own page and fits the core dental thermoforming range, so the firm's visible commitment favors keeping it even though there is no recent evidence about it.
The PETG blank is a low-cost extension of an established thermoforming line with its own page, so dropping it would release few resources and would reverse a visible commitment.
Public commitment to the UV-curing lacquer is lower because it was only mentioned on the website, but as a cheap consumable for the announced digital workflow it is more likely kept than withdrawn.
The intraoral contrast spray supports intraoral scanning, which is central to the firm's announced digital direction, so management would attribute weak sales to how slowly scanning is being adopted.
Custom earmolds are core to the firm's custom-device manufacturing base, and the investment in a multi-model line encourages persistence.
Custom hearing protection uses the existing earmold production capabilities, so management would attribute weak results to temporary market build-up, including pandemic effects.
